location.section: hymns on benefits in the present life

paraphrase: When one says Namu Amida Butsu, the benefits in this present life are boundless: evil karma of transmigration is removed, untimely death is averted, the gods of heaven and earth and the guardian kings protect the person day and night, the demons are afraid.
speaker: Shinran
notes: Not in local corpus; recalled, no original quoted. Recalled in outline.

paraphrase: Those who rejoice in shinjin are said to be equal to the Tathāgatas; great shinjin is buddha-nature, buddha-nature is the Tathāgata.
speaker: Shinran
notes: Not in local corpus; recalled, no original quoted.
